integrated_multimodal_description: Claymation plasticine stop-motion, handcrafted modelling clay with visible fingerprints and matte finish, photographed on a miniature practical set. Cool ceiling panels light the tiled horticulture workshop of a hospital day clinic. At the center of a steel bench a potted shrub has a flat fan of dry leaves on a slender stem leaning forward. A slot in front of the pot is longer than the fan but only a finger wide. Its balanced steel flap caps a ceramic-lined clipping box with a broad glass front, a solid back facing the workers and a small steady flame inside. A wood-based sand timer stands behind the pot. A smooth caliper lies on the left; closed pruning snips and one folded invoice with a perforated edge lie on the right. TEO (frame left): tall thin white clay man, huge straw-blond walrus moustache, teal knitted beanie with cream stripes, red-and-black checked flannel shirt, brown suspenders, khaki trousers, dark boots. JUCA (frame right): short wide Black clay man, burnt-brown flat cap, mustard cable-knit sweater, olive-green trousers, pale wooden clogs, pencil behind the right ear. Exactly two clay puppets appear in the frame: TEO stays at frame left and JUCA stays at frame right; no other people or animals appear. AT START: The finger-high stump fits the caliper held by TEO at left. The fan crown lies flat across the closed flap. The snips are back at JUCA's right beside the folded invoice; the doctor keeps the stethoscope bell on the running sand timer. [Shot 1] Bench wide. JUCA gives the flat fan one light pat with his right palm. Both fixed lips support it like a lid. TEO bends sideways to sight along the short length of slot still showing at one end. [Shot 2] At 00:03.000, the camera cuts to High front angle. TEO lifts the caliper off the stump and turns its gap across the slot. JUCA grips the cut stalk with his right hand and lifts that end first. The heavier fringe hangs down, turning the fan edge on. From above, the crown that covered the slot makes a single thin stripe between the open caliper tips. [Shot 3] At 00:07.300, the camera cuts to Return to the frontal wide. JUCA lowers the long leafy edge onto the closed flap but keeps the weight in his right hand. From this angle the thin stripe is a broad upside-down fan with the stalk sticking up. They do not speak and their mouths do not move, but they breathe, swallow and react with their whole bodies. AT END: TEO holds the caliper across the slot from the left. JUCA grips the stalk in his right hand with the fan crown fringe down on the closed flap. The stump stands behind it; the doctor listens to the sand timer and the snips and folded invoice stay right.
overall_soundscape: Dry leaves crunch lightly under JUCA's pat; the steel caliper tip rasps softly off the ceramic rim; the woody stalk creaks once in the turning grip; the dry fringe brushes the steel flap in a single soft sweep as it settles.
non_diegetic_music: Pizzicato cello turns the opening pair of notes into a quiet waltz in three.
